newsitem.title: USA: Nebraska cattle roundup - active trade at $70 Tues.
newsitem.headline: Nebraska cattle roundup - active trade at $70 Tues.

text.p: Trading on slaughter steers and heifers was very active on Tuesday, USDA said. Compared to last Thursday live sales $1.00-$2.00 higher; dressed basis $2.00 to mostly $3.00 higher. Demand and seller interest excellent all day. Many of the week's showlists now depleted.
Sales Confirmed 77,600. Week ago 29,500. Yr ago 35,300
For wk: 91,300. Sm Pd Lst Wk 39,000. Sm Pd Lst Yr 42,400

Slaughter Steers: Select and Choice 2-3 1175-1350 lbs: 68.50-70.00 (weighted average 69.71); dressed 111.00-112.00; late mostly 112.00; couple pens Choice 112.50-113.00; instances early to 110.00. weighted average 111.97 )
Slaughter heifers: Select and Choice 2-3 1050-1225 lbs: 68.50-70.00 (weighted average 69.75); dressed 111.00-112.00; late trades mostly 112.00; few early to 110.00 (weighted average 111.88)
